description: A slider that thickens under the pointer and, if you pull past either end, stretches like a rubber band and springs back.
interactionNotes: Drag or click on the track; the track thickens under your finger and, if you pull past either end, it stretches and then springs back. In right-to-left the track fills from the **right** and the arrow keys are mirrored too (left = more); in vertical mode it fills from the bottom. The mouse wheel (when `wheel` is on) and the Home/End keys can change the value as well.

props.value: Controlled value. Omit it for the value to be internal.
props.defaultValue: Starting value when it is not controlled.
props.isStepped: The value snaps to the `stepSize` grid.
props.stepSize: Size of each step when `isStepped` is on.
props.onChangeEnd: End of a drag, key, or wheel — once.
props.orientation: Track direction; vertical fills from the bottom.
props.startIcon: Icon of the low end. It is logical: it sits on the left in LTR and on the right in RTL. `null` hides it.
props.endIcon: Icon of the high end. On the right in LTR and on the left in RTL. `null` hides it.
props.iconPlacement: Outside the track or inside it. For inside, the thickness should be around 40px or the icons get clipped.
props.valuePosition: Where the number goes: above the track, in a moving bubble, inside the track, or nowhere.
props.formatValue: Formats the number and `aria-valuetext`; by default Persian digits via `Intl.NumberFormat('fa-IR')`.
props.ticks: Dots on the track: every step, every tenth, or explicit values.
props.thumb: Round handle at the head of the fill.
props.fillFrom: The value the fill grows from; the middle of the range means a two-sided fill.
props.thickness: Track thickness at rest, in pixels.
props.activeThickness: Track thickness on hover, focus, or drag.
props.radius: Track corner radius; omit it for the track to be fully round.
props.restOpacity: Brightness at rest; it reaches 1 when active.
props.growOnHover: Hover also activates the track; off means press/focus only.
props.maxStretch: Maximum stretch past either end, in pixels; zero turns it off.
props.bounce: How much the return spring wobbles, 0 to 0.95.
props.jumpToClick: A click on the track puts the value right there; off means it drags from the current value.
props.wheel: Let the mouse wheel change the value (it captures scrolling over the track).
props.rangeColor: Color of the fill; in the demo the default is the theme's mono and the variants add an accent.
props.iconColor: Color of the icons outside the track.
props.contentColor: Color of the number/icon/tick over the empty groove.
props.fillContentColor: Color of the content over the fill; `auto` picks opaque ink from the brightness of the fill color.
props.disabled: Turns interaction off and dims the whole slider.
props.dir: Provide the direction manually; by default it is read from the computed `direction`.
props.ref: Imperative handle with `bump(side)` — stretches the track past one end and springs it back without changing the value; for preview drivers and storytelling.
props.style: Inline style; it is applied after the color variables.

tips: In right-to-left the track fills from the right; the left key means 'more'. The same convention holds in `wake-slider`.
For a two-sided fill (like camera exposure), set `fillFrom` to the middle of the range and turn `thumb` on.
For an inside icon, take `thickness` to around 40px; otherwise the icons get clipped in a thin track.
With `ticks={[0]}` you show only the zero dot; a numeric `ticks` brings in every step.
If the mouse wheel should scroll the page, leave `wheel` off (the default).
